name: Better User Accounts
description: Provides various improvements to user profiles, e.g. custom labels for the user account view/edit local-task tabs and hiding the obsolete current-password field on the account edit form.
project_description:
The Better User Accounts Module provides various improvements to user profiles:

 
 Custom labels for account edit and view tabs. 
 The option to hide the password retype field on the account edit form when it is not needed. 
 

 Back to top 

 
Requirements 
 This module requires no modules outside of Drupal core.

 Back to top 

 
Installation 
 Install as you would normally install a contributed Drupal module. For further information, see Installing Drupal Modules .

 Back to top 

 
Configuration 
 In order to customize / enable the features of this module, go to Administration » Configuration » People » Better User Accounts settings and modify them there.
